definitions.explanation: A government official appointed to reside in a foreign city to protect the interests and assist citizens of the appointing country. Operates from a consulate.

examples.japanese: {領事|りょうじ}に{相談|そうだん}した。
{日本|にほん}{領事館|りょうじかん}でビザを{申請|しんせい}した。
examples.english: I applied for a visa at the Japanese consulate.

examples.japanese: {総|そう}{領事|りょうじ}が{現地|げんち}の{日本人|にほんじん}コミュニティーと{交流|こうりゅう}する{場|ば}が{設|もう}けられた。
examples.english: An event was organized for the consul general to interact with the local Japanese community.

notes:
USAGE:
{領事|りょうじ} refers to the official, while {領事館|りょうじかん} refers to the consulate (the office/building). The senior consul in a city is called {総|そう}{領事|りょうじ} (consul general).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {領事館|りょうじかん} (consulate)
- {総|そう}{領事|りょうじ} (consul general)
- {名誉|めいよ}{領事|りょうじ} (honorary consul)
- {領事|りょうじ}{業務|ぎょうむ} (consular services)
